name: Mirchi Ka Salan
instructions: 1. Dry roast peanuts, sesame seeds, coconut, coriander seeds, and cumin seeds until fragrant; grind into a smooth paste with minimal water.
2. Slit the green chilies, remove some seeds if desired, and shallow fry them in oil until slightly blistered; remove and set aside.
3. In the same pan, temper mustard seeds, fenugreek seeds, and curry leaves.
4. Add onions and ginger-garlic paste, sautéing until golden brown.
5. Add the ground nut paste along with turmeric and red chili powder, cooking until oil separates.
6. Mix in the tamarind pulp and enough water to reach desired gravy consistency.
7. Add the fried chilies and simmer on low heat for 5-7 minutes to allow flavors to penetrate.
8. Serve hot with Hyderabadi Biryani or Bagara Rice.
description: Mirchi Ka Salan is an iconic Hyderabadi delicacy often served as a quintessential accompaniment to Biryani. It is a harmonious blend of nutty, tangy, and spicy flavors that reflects the rich culinary heritage of the Nizami kitchens in Telangana.
